plan.name: GRASP_OBJECT
plan.instruction: Grasp the blender lid securely at its handle and lift it clear.
plan.contract: held AND lifted>=0.05m AND stable_for(20) AND no_disallowed_contact

plan.name: MOVE_OBJECT
plan.instruction: Move the held blender lid to the pre-place region above the blender while maintaining a stable grasp and avoiding disallowed contact.
plan.contract: held AND at_target(xy<=0.06m,z 0.015-0.25m) AND stable_for(3) AND no_disallowed_contact

plan.name: PLACE_OBJECT
plan.instruction: Place the blender lid on the blender, release it after it is stably supported, then move the gripper clear.
plan.contract: supported_by AND released AND upright_error<=7deg AND gripper_clear>=0.15m
